written.summary: The child told that they got a detention because they handed their homework in late. They finished it on Sunday but forgot to upload it. They uploaded it in the corridor before the lesson but Miss said it was after the deadline. They had to go at lunch on Wednesday to Room 12 with Mr Khan and did work in silence. They finished a geography sheet and went to afternoon lessons. They said it was the rule and they still didn't like it.
